```{r load_counts_data, include=FALSE}
counts <- read.csv("data/Master_QAQC_LightTrap_Counts.csv") %>%
  filter(!Code %in% c("KLE", "BLU", "TAK", "HOT")) %>% #filter out sites that have never had a complete season of data collection
  filter(!Month %in% c("Sep", "Oct"))

counts$Site[counts$Site == "Pacific Science Enterprise Centre"] <- "DFO PSEC"
counts$Site[counts$Site == "Pacific Biological Station"]        <- "DFO PBS"
counts$Site[counts$Site == "Institute of Ocean Sciences"]       <- "DFO IOS"
counts$Site[counts$Site == "Victoria Inner Harbour"]            <- "Victoria"

counts$Date   <- ymd(counts$Date)
counts$Year   <- factor(counts$Year)
counts$week   <- week(counts$Date)
counts$day_month <- format(counts$Date, "%m-%d")
counts$loc.lat <- factor(counts$Site,
                         levels = unique(counts$Site[order(counts$lat, decreasing = TRUE)]))

# Year totals (daily CPUE and catch across all sites)
make_total <- function(yr) {
  counts %>%
    filter(Year == yr) %>%
    group_by(Date, Year, week) %>%
    summarize(CPUE.total  = sum(CPUE_Hour,     na.rm = TRUE),
              count.total = sum(TotalMmagister, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
}

total2022 <- make_total(2022)
total2023 <- make_total(2023)
total2024 <- make_total(2024)
total2025 <- make_total(2025)

total <- bind_rows(total2022, total2023, total2024, total2025)
total$month_day <- format(total$Date, "%m-%d")

# Weekly background line used in faceted CPUE plots
total_week2025 <- counts %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(Date, week) %>%
  summarize(CPUE.total = sum(CPUE_Hour, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarize(CPUE.week = mean(CPUE.total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(total2025, ., by = "week")

# Year colours used across multiple figures
year_colours <- c("2022" = "#ff5a5e", "2023" = "#c31e23", "2024" = "#99c6cc", "2025" = "#0d7d87")
```

```{r load_map_data, include=FALSE}
counts_map <- read_csv("data/Master_QAQC_LightTrap_Counts.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Date, Code, Site, lat, lon, CPUE_Hour) %>%
  filter(!Code %in% c("KLE", "BLU", "TAK")) %>%
  mutate(Month = format(as.Date(Date), "%B"))

CPUE.bymonth.mean <- aggregate(CPUE_Hour ~ Site + lat + lon + Year + Month,
                               counts_map, mean)
CPUE.bymonth.mean$Month <- factor(CPUE.bymonth.mean$Month,
                                  levels = c("March", "April", "May", "June",
                                             "July", "August", "September", "October"))
CPUE.bymonth.mean <- CPUE.bymonth.mean[order(CPUE.bymonth.mean$Month), ]
colnames(CPUE.bymonth.mean)[6] <- "MeanCPUE"
CPUE.bymonth.mean <- CPUE.bymonth.mean[
  !CPUE.bymonth.mean$Month %in% c("March"), ]

CPUE.bymonth.mean.nonzero <- CPUE.bymonth.mean[CPUE.bymonth.mean$MeanCPUE != 0, ]
CPUE.bymonth.mean.zeros   <- CPUE.bymonth.mean[CPUE.bymonth.mean$MeanCPUE == 0, ]

land  <- st_read("shapefiles/Grey_WA_OR.shp") %>% st_transform(crs = 4326)
water <- st_read("shapefiles/NW_Marine.shp")  %>% st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

```{r load_temp_data, include=FALSE}
Data_temp <- read.csv("data/Master_QAQC_LightTrap_Counts.csv")
Data_temp$Date <- as.Date(Data_temp$Date, "%Y-%m-%d")
Data_temp$Year <- as.numeric(format(Data_temp$Date, "%Y"))
Data_temp$Site[Data_temp$Site == "Pacific Biological Station"] <- "PBS"
Data_temp$Site[Data_temp$Site == "Comox Marina"]               <- "Comox"
Data_temp$Site[Data_temp$Site == "Campbell River Aquarium"]    <- "Campbell River"
Data_temp$Site[Data_temp$Site == "Victoria Inner Harbour"]     <- "Victoria"
Data_temp$Site[Data_temp$Site == "Saltspring Island"]          <- "Salt Spring"
CPUE.25 <- Data_temp[Data_temp$Year == 2025, ]

cleantemp <- function(f) {
  temp <- read.csv(paste0("data/HOBO_Data/2025/", f))
  if (ncol(temp) == 5) temp <- temp[, 1:4]
  if ("Temp_F" %in% colnames(temp)) temp$Temp_F <- (temp$Temp_F - 32) * (5 / 9)
  colnames(temp) <- c("Site", "Date", "Time", "Temp_C")
  temp
}

temp.data <- list.files("data/HOBO_Data/2025", pattern = "*.csv") %>%
  lapply(cleantemp) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(Site != "")

temp.data$DateTime_GMT.08.00 <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(temp.data$Date, temp.data$Time), tz = "GMT", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
)

temp.agg2 <- aggregate(Temp_C ~ Date + Site, temp.data, mean)
temp.CPUE  <- merge(CPUE.25[, c(1, 2, 7, 16)], temp.agg2, by = c("Date", "Site"))
temp.CPUE$logplus1_CPUE <- log(temp.CPUE$CPUE_Hour + 1)

temp.agg <- aggregate(Temp_C ~ Date, temp.data,
                      FUN = function(x) c(Lower = quantile(x, .25), Upper = quantile(x, .75)))
temp.agg <- do.call(data.frame, temp.agg)
colnames(temp.agg) <- c("Date", "Lower", "Upper")
temp.agg$Fill_code <- "Interquartile Range (all sites)"

daily.agg <- aggregate(Temp_C ~ Date + Site, temp.data,
                       FUN = function(x) c(Min = min(x), Mean = mean(x), Max = max(x)))
daily.agg <- do.call(data.frame, daily.agg)
daily.agg$Line_code <- "Daily Maximum"

site_levels <- c("Prince Rupert", "Masset", "Daajing Giids", "Echo Bay", "Quathiaski Cove",
                 "Campbell River", "Comox", "Pender Harbour", "Baynes Sound", "Ford Cove",
                 "Tofino", "Horseshoe Bay", "Port Moody", "PBS", "Heather Marina",
                 "Indian Arm", "Descanso Bay", "Silva Bay", "Retreat Cove", "Whaler Bay",
                 "Miners Bay", "Hope Bay", "Salt Spring", "Cowichan Bay",
                 "James Isl. Pier", "Gorge", "Victoria", "Sooke")

temp.data$Site <- factor(temp.data$Site, levels = site_levels)
daily.agg$Site <- factor(daily.agg$Site, levels = site_levels)
temp.data <- subset(temp.data, Date >= "2025-04-15" & Date <= "2025-08-31")
daily.agg <- subset(daily.agg, Date >= "2025-04-15" & Date <= "2025-08-31")
temp.agg  <- subset(temp.agg,  Date >= "2025-04-15" & Date <= "2025-08-31")
daily.agg$Date <- as.Date(daily.agg$Date)
temp.agg$Date  <- as.Date(temp.agg$Date)
temp.CPUE$Site <- factor(temp.CPUE$Site, levels = site_levels)

temp_colours <- c("#2b323f", "#2e4057", "#00798c", "#edae49", "#d1495b")
```

```{r load_sal_data, include=FALSE}
counts_sal <- read.csv("data/Master_QAQC_LightTrap_Counts.csv") %>%

      "Sooke Basin"                       = "Sooke"
    ),
    Date = ymd(Date),

    week = week(ymd(Date))

  mutate(Date = ymd(Date))

  mutate(Date = ymd(Date))

salCPUE <- merge(salinity_daily, counts_sal, by = c("Date", "Site"))

sal.agg <- aggregate(Salinity ~ Date, salinity_trimmed,
                     FUN = function(x) c(Lower = quantile(x, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         Upper = quantile(x, .75, na.rm = TRUE)))
sal.agg <- do.call(data.frame, sal.agg)
colnames(sal.agg) <- c("Date", "Lower", "Upper")
sal.agg$Fill_code <- "Interquartile Range (all sites)"

daily.agg.sal <- aggregate(Salinity ~ Date + Site, salinity_trimmed,
                           FUN = function(x) c(Min  = min(x,  na.rm = TRUE),
                                               Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               Max  = max(x,  na.rm = TRUE)))
daily.agg.sal <- do.call(data.frame, daily.agg.sal)
daily.agg.sal$Line_code <- "Daily Maximum"
daily.agg.sal$Site <- factor(daily.agg.sal$Site, levels = site_levels)

salCPUE$Site <- factor(salCPUE$Site,

                                  "Indian Arm", "Descanso Bay", "Silva Bay", "Whaler Bay",
                                  "Miners Bay", "Hope Bay", "Cowichan Bay", "Victoria", "Sooke"))

sal_colours <- c("#ecc81b", "#ed9a2c", "#e98d38", "#dd6f4e",
                 "#cd5561", "#a12188", "#7a1c9c", "#0c157e")
```

```{r load_timing_data, include=FALSE}
# Unfiltered counts — timing plots need Sep/Oct and all sites
counts_timing <- read.csv("data/Master_QAQC_LightTrap_Counts.csv")

# Sites with >= 4 years of monitoring (excl. Retreat Cove)
site_list <- counts_timing %>%
  filter(Site != "Retreat Cove") %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarize(n_years = n_distinct(Year)) %>%
  filter(n_years >= 4) %>%
  pull(Site)

# Multi-year timing summary
timing_summ <- counts_timing %>%
  filter(Site %in% site_list) %>%
  group_by(Site, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    tot_dung       = sum(TotalMmagister, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_detection = as.Date(min(ifelse(TotalMmagister > 0, Date, NA), na.rm = TRUE)),
    last_detection  = as.Date(max(ifelse(TotalMmagister > 0, Date, NA), na.rm = TRUE)),
    lat             = median(lat),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(lat)) %>%
  mutate(
    first_detection_doy = lubridate::yday(first_detection),
    last_detection_doy  = lubridate::yday(last_detection),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = rev(c("Pender Harbour", "Ford Cove", "Horseshoe Bay",
                                       "Pacific Biological Station", "Heather Marina",
                                       "Descanso Bay", "Silva Bay", "Miners Bay",
                                       "Hope Bay", "Cowichan Bay", "Whaler Bay"))),
    Year = factor(Year, levels = sort(unique(Year)))
  )

# 2025 all-sites timing summary
timing_2025_all <- counts_timing %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    first_detection = suppressWarnings(min(Date[TotalMmagister > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    last_detection  = suppressWarnings(max(Date[TotalMmagister > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    lat             = median(lat),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    first_detection = ifelse(is.infinite(first_detection), NA, first_detection),
    last_detection  = ifelse(is.infinite(last_detection),  NA, last_detection)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_detection) & !is.na(last_detection)) %>%
  arrange(desc(lat)) %>%
  mutate(
    first_detection_doy = lubridate::yday(first_detection),
    last_detection_doy  = lubridate::yday(last_detection),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = rev(Site))
  )

breaks_doy    <- c(1, 32, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335)
labels_months <- month.abb

colors7    <- viridis(length(site_list),                       begin = 0.2, end = 0.95, direction = -1, option = "A")
colors_all <- viridis(length(unique(timing_2025_all$Site)),    begin = 0.2, end = 0.95, direction = -1, option = "A")
```

## Figure 2

```{r delivery_barplot_2025_all_sites}
timing_plot_2025_all <- ggplot(timing_2025_all) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = Site, ymin = first_detection_doy, ymax = last_detection_doy),
    size = 4, color = "#30106B"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(timing_2025_all, first_detection_doy == last_detection_doy),
    aes(x = Site, y = first_detection_doy),
    size = 4, color = "#30106B"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_doy, labels = labels_months) +
  labs(title = "2025") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.title         = element_blank(),
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_flip()

timing_plot_2025_all
```

```{r delivery_barplot_allyears}
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 15),
    strip.text         = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
```

```{r CPUE_Hour_North_map}
map_theme <- theme(
  axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),

  theme_bw() +
  geom_sf(data = water, fill = "paleturquoise3", color = "turquoise4") +
  geom_sf(data = land,  fill = "grey96", color = NA) +

           expand = FALSE, clip = "on", datum = NA) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(CPUE.bymonth.mean.nonzero, Year %in% 2023:2025, Month != "April"),
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = MeanCPUE),
```

```{r SGI_CPUE_ALL}
sgi_sites   <- c("Hope Bay", "Miners Bay", "Retreat Cove", "Whaler Bay", "Saltspring Island")
sgi_colours <- c("Hope Bay" = "#CC79A7", "Miners Bay" = "#56B4E9", "Retreat Cove" = "#E69F00",
                 "Whaler Bay" = "#009E73", "Saltspring Island" = "magenta")

sgi_cpue <- function(yr)
  ggplot(filter(counts, Year == yr & Site %in% sgi_sites),
         aes(Date, CPUE_Hour, colour = Site)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = sgi_colours) +
    ylab("CPUE (crabs per hour)") + labs(title = yr) + theme_bw()

SGI_2023_CPUE <- sgi_cpue(2023)
SGI_2024_CPUE <- sgi_cpue(2024)
SGI_2025_CPUE <- sgi_cpue(2025)

SGI_2023_CPUE / SGI_2024_CPUE / SGI_2025_CPUE
```

```{r mainland_CPUE_ALL}
mainland_2023_CPUE <- ggplot(filter(counts, Year == 2023 & Site %in% mainland_sites_2023_24),
                             aes(Date, CPUE_Hour, colour = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = mainland_colours) +
  ylab("CPUE (crabs per hour)") + labs(title = "2023") + theme_bw()

mainland_2024_CPUE <- ggplot(filter(counts, Year == 2024 & Site %in% mainland_sites_2023_24),
                             aes(Date, CPUE_Hour, colour = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = mainland_colours) +
  ylab("CPUE (crabs per hour)") + labs(title = "2024") + theme_bw()

mainland_2025_CPUE <- ggplot(filter(counts, Year == 2025 & Site %in% mainland_sites_2025),
                             aes(Date, CPUE_Hour, colour = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = mainland_colours) +
  ylab("CPUE (crabs per hour)") + labs(title = "2025") + theme_bw()

mainland_2023_CPUE / mainland_2024_CPUE / mainland_2025_CPUE
```

## Figure 22

```{r rainsalinity_indianarm}
rain_indian_arm <- read.csv("data/2025/portmoody_precip.csv") %>%
  select(Station.Name, Date, total_precip_mm) %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date))

sal_rain_ind <- daily.agg.sal %>%
  filter(Site == "Indian Arm") %>%
  select(Date, Salinity.Mean) %>%
  merge(rain_indian_arm, by = "Date", all = TRUE)

salrain_ind <- ggplot(sal_rain_ind, aes(Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Salinity.Mean, color = "Salinity (PSU)"), size = 1) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = total_precip_mm / 5, fill = "Rainfall (mm)"),
           stat = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Salinity (PSU)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~. * 5, name = "Daily Rainfall (mm)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Salinity (PSU)" = "#0c157e")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rainfall (mm)" = "#2e4057")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Indian Arm: Daily Mean Salinity vs Rainfall (2025)", x = "Date") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())

salrain_ind
```
